senses.definition: A type of fast motor torpedo boat used by the US Navy during World War II.
senses.example: The PT boat is not merely a small boat for attack in rivers and inland seas. It is a deadly offensive weapon for use under the most trying conditions [...]

senses.definition: The structural core of folic acid, consisting of a pteridine ring linked to PABA.
A type of soft, calcareous pelagic sediment found on the deep-sea floor, consisting primarily of the skeletal remains of pteropods.
An aromatic carboxylic acid composed of a pteridine ring and a 4-aminobenzoic acid. It is a common structural feature of folic acid and its derivatives.
folic acid
folic acid, a polycyclic heterocyclic carboxylic acid of the vitamin B complex, essential for cell growth and reproduction.
folic acid
An anteroposterior canal in the base of each medial pterygoid plate of the sphenoid bone that gives passage to the Vidian artery and the Vidian nerve.
Either of two muscles arising respectively from the lateral and medial surfaces of the lateral pterygoid process which serve to move the mandible forwards and to the side.
Either of two branches of the mandibular nerve.
Either of two vertical plates making up a pterygoid process of the sphenoid bone.
Each of a pair of projections extending downward from each side of the sphenoid bone in humans and other mammals.

A fibrous seam that descends from the pterygoid hamulus of the medial pterygoid plate to the mylohyoid line of the mandible and that separates and gives rise to the superior pharyngeal constrictor and the buccinator.

A vertical gap between the lateral pterygoid plate of the pterygoid process of the sphenoid bone and the maxilla that descends at right angles to the medial end of the inferior orbital fissure and gives passage to part of the maxillary artery and vein.
Synonym of pterygopalatine fossa.

A small triangular space beneath the apex of the orbit that is bounded above by the sphenoid bone and the orbital process of the palatine bone, in front by the maxilla, medially by the palatine bone, and behind by the pterygoid process of the sphenoid bone and that contains among other structures the pterygopalatine ga

An autonomic ganglion of the maxillary nerve that is situated in the pterygopalatine fossa and that receives preganglionic parasympathetic fibers from the facial nerve and sends postganglionic fibers to the nasal mucosa, palate, pharynx, and orbit.
Synonym of syntonic comma.
A geocentric model of the solar system, described by the eponymous astronomer.
senses.example: The theories in your books are almost as obsolete as the Ptolemaic System.

senses.definition: A theorem that states in a cyclic quadrilateral, the product of the lengths of its diagonals is equal to the sum of the products of the lengths of the two pairs of opposite sides.
Proprietary Limited, a type of company that has one or more shareholders and in which the number of shareholders is limited.
senses.example: Both companies stem from the formation in 1926 of the Australian Cream Tartar Company Pty Ltd to undertake the manufacture of cream of tartar and tartaric acid.
